validation.ledgers: validate.py ledger cut-editors/<id>/ledger.json --recipes ... -> 0 errors for A1 (480), B1 (564), B2 (564), B3 (612); every source PNG re-hashed (RGB24 md5) equals the manifest frame_md5
validation.mp4: rough cuts are lossy H.264 (crf 17) review copies; frame counts equal recipe totals; decoded frames at cut points match the frozen PNG at 40.8-43.1 dB PSNR. md5 membership is a property of the ledger/PNG path, which the assembler must use for the final render.

readings.method: Each rough cut was checked frame-exact (cut-point pairs in cut-editors/<id>/cuts.jpg; decoded mp4 frames at the cut frames match the frozen PNGs at PSNR 40.8-43.1 dB, i.e. cuts land on the recipe frames) and its flow viewed as a 2 fps strip (strip.jpg) at the recipe's real durations. The cuts are silent: these are picture-only readings (screening-1 conditions minus the shared bed). They are the editor's own readings, not the independent critic's.

A1.perceived_cause: the station timetable: the clock opens the shift and every following image is someone doing a job at night (mail, timekeeping, boarding, reservations, departures), closing on the empty hall at 1 a.m.
A1.person_acting: nobody in particular; a sequence of workers and travellers. The woman with the box reads as a mail-room worker; the red cap is one portrait in the series.
A1.decisive_adjacency: 01 -> 02 (clock -> woman with parcel): the parcel enters as scheduled work; 07 -> 08 closes it as the end of the night.
A1.risk_noted: Two things could tint A: the woman's sidelong, wary glance is in the photograph itself (frames 0-71 as in B), and A contains a latent watch -> door -> stare triad at 03 -> 04 -> 05. At 2.0 s, mid-series and AFTER the door, 05 reads as a portrait rather than a look-out. If the critic finds A sinister, the permitted repair is A1b: 05 0->35 (36 f = 1.5 s, the plan's minimum) and 06 0->71 (72 f), total still 480; controlling variable = glance duration (A 1.5 s vs B 5.0 s). Not applied; 02 keeps its full 3 s per the user's note.

B1.perceived_cause: the red cap's stare. He looks almost straight into the lens for 5 s at half speed (the push creeps), so the hard cut to the carriage door reads as what he is watching; the woman then appears glancing sideways over a box, as if checking she is seen. The parcel is moving under observation.
B1.person_acting: the red cap as look-out (opens, holds); the woman as courier; the conductor with his watch as the one timing it; the soldiers' file as the getaway crowd.
B1.decisive_adjacency: 05 -> 04 -> 02 (5.0 s stare -> door -> woman with parcel looking off-frame). Secondary: 03 -> 01rev (watch, then the clock arriving last and pulling away); at 1.5 s the reversed pull reads as 'the clock, late' rather than strongly as an alibi.
B1.verdict: changed: reads as a watched handoff, not routine. No duration change; every projection >= 2.0 s except 01rev (1.5 s, the plan minimum), glance 5.0 s, 02 a full 3.0 s (24->95), 08 held 4.0 s.
B1.vs_A: same eight prints, same pixels; the difference is position (05 first vs fifth), duration (5.0 s vs 2.0 s, speed 0.5) and the 05-04-02 adjacency.

B2-rev-adjacency.perceived_cause: an exchanged look: the stare cuts straight to the woman's sidelong glance, so the two seem to look at each other (accomplices); the door after her reads as her exit.
B2-rev-adjacency.person_acting: the red cap and the woman together; the door becomes her route out rather than what he watches.
B2-rev-adjacency.verdict: also changed, more direct but loses B1's spatial logic (stare -> place -> person). With the soundtrack fixed, mix B's door latch (pre-lapped 6 f before cut-B frame 120) now lands on the 05 -> 02 cut instead of the door: the latch is heard on the parcel. That desync is the test of this branch.

B3-glance-hold.perceived_cause: as B1, with the stare pressed further: at 7 s the push reaches ~x1.21 on his eyes and the hold becomes surveillance; the door cut lands harder.
B3-glance-hold.person_acting: the red cap as look-out, more emphatically.
B3-glance-hold.verdict: strengthens B slightly; costs 48 f (cut B 25.5 s, film 66 -> 68 s, both inside the plan's 20-30 s / 60-75 s limits; every later S7+ frame shifts +48). Risk: past ~6 s the hold reads as a portrait study. Use only if the critic reports that B1 reads unchanged.

B4-delayed-cue.note: picture identical to B1 (no reading change in picture-only viewing); see sound_notes.
